title: The Late Vow
author: Felix Okafor
blurb: Vesper Fairweather, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
